title: Engine deceleration
objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine deceleration conforms to the aeroplane.
initial_conditions_catalog: Flt cond: Ground | Alt[ft]: 755 | IAS[kts]: 0 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 100
duration_note: Test runs for 21 seconds total (5.0 s baseline hold + 16.0 s post-movement response).
report_format: 5-page official engine report (Page 1: Initial Conditions, Page 2: Group 1 Ground Speed, Page 3: Group 2 Throttle/RPM, Page 4: Group 3 Power/Fuel, Page 5: Ti/Tt Response Analysis)
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% Tt (Total time from initial throttle movement until 90% flight idle throttle movement)
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative; changes only via test settings dialog
